title: vLLM media acquisition applies resource limits too late
summary: Media acquisition can consume memory or bandwidth before size/item limits are applied. The advisory groups four paths under one boundary issue; authentication and exploitability depend on entry point and configuration, with an opt-in Rust tokenize route separately described.
ai_role: The project advisory credits GPT-5.5-Cyber through Patch the Planet, a Trail of Bits and OpenAI effort.
classification_note: The cited source documents public disclosure; it does not establish whether the issue was previously known to defenders or exploited before disclosure.
remediation_note: The advisory lists versions through 0.29.0 affected and versions >0.29.0 patched, while detailed reproduction confirms 0.25.1. Verify the lower bound and entry-point applicability before upgrading.

impacts.conditions: Media resource use can occur before size/item limits; exploitability and authentication conditions vary by entry point and configuration.
impacts.exploitation: The cited primary source does not report observed exploitation.
